inputs.description: Select the user program to debug

tasks.label: xv6: refresh compile_commands
args: export XV6_AUTO_COMPILE_COMMANDS=0; source ./.envrc; export XV6_AUTO_COMPILE_COMMANDS=1; _xv6_refresh_compile_commands force

tasks.label: xv6: qemu-gdb
args: source ./.envrc; port="$XV6_GDBPORT"; cpus="$XV6_CPUS"; pidfile="$PWD/.direnv/xv6-qemu-gdb.pid"; mkdir -p "$PWD/.direnv"; rm -f "$pidfile"; is_listening() { if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then ss -ltnH "sport = :$port" | grep -q .; elif command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then lsof -nP -iTCP:"$port" -sTCP:LISTEN | grep -q .; else return 1; fi; }; if is_listening; then echo "TCP port $port is already in use" >&2; exit 1; fi; make kernel/kernel fs.img; rm -f .gdbinit; echo QEMU_GDB_STARTING; parent=$$; (until is_listening; do if ! kill -0 "$parent" 2>/dev/null; then exit 1; fi; sleep 0.05; done; echo QEMU_GDB_READY) & exec "$XV6_QEMU" -machine virt -bios none -kernel kernel/kernel -m 128M -smp "$cpus" -nographic -drive file=fs.img,if=none,format=raw,id=x0 -device virtio-blk-device,drive=x0,bus=virtio-mmio-bus.0 -S -pidfile "$pidfile" -gdb "tcp::$port"

tasks.label: xv6: stop qemu
args: source ./.envrc >/dev/null; pidfile="$PWD/.direnv/xv6-qemu-gdb.pid"; if [ -s "$pidfile" ]; then pid="$(cat "$pidfile")"; if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; rm -f "$pidfile"; else qemu="$(basename "$XV6_QEMU")"; pkill -f "$qemu.*-gdb tcp::$XV6_GDBPORT" || true; fi
